# Organic Lawn Care & Landscaping | Chicago & Milwaukee

## Chicago and Milwaukee's First Choice for Organic-Forward and Sustainable Lawn Care and Landscaping

Creating and Caring for Environmentally Sound Landscapes Throughout Chicagoland and Metro Milwaukee Since 2007

## Why Choose Greenwise?

Serving homeowners and businesses across Chicago and Milwaukee, Greenwise crafts safe, healthy lawns and landscapes tailored to your needs. We lighten our footprint by using battery-powered equipment in Chicagoland and by offering organic and natural lawn programs for those who want a chemical-free yard.

![Beautiful front yard with landscaped bushes](https://www.iamgreenwise.com/front-yard-and-bushes-480x300.png)

![Natural stone retaining wall with plantings](https://www.iamgreenwise.com/retaining-wall-on-grass.png)

![Outdoor patio with fireplace seating area](https://www.iamgreenwise.com/chairs-in-front-of-fireplace-480x300.png)

![Garden with flowering plants and outdoor fireplace](https://www.iamgreenwise.com/flowers-and-fire-place-480x300.png)

![Beautiful organic lawn](https://www.iamgreenwise.com/front-lawn-of-chicago-house.jpeg)

### Organic & Natural Lawn Care

We offer organic lawn care programs that create beautiful, healthy lawns without synthetic chemicals. Safe for your family, pets, and the environment while delivering exceptional results.

*   Organic Fertilization
*   Natural Weed Control
*   Lawn Aeration
*   Organic Seeding

[View Organic Lawn Care](https://www.iamgreenwise.com/services/organic-lawn-care)

![Outdoor patio with fireplace seating area](https://www.iamgreenwise.com/flowers-and-fire-place.png)

### Landscape Maintenance

Professional landscape maintenance using battery-powered equipment. From weekly mowing to seasonal cleanups, we keep your property looking its best year-round.

*   Mowing
*   Garden Bed Maintenance
*   Seasonal Cleanups
*   Mulch Installation

[View Landscape Maintenance](https://www.iamgreenwise.com/services/landscape-maintenance)

![Beautiful front yard with landscaped bushes](https://www.iamgreenwise.com/front-of-house-landscaping.jpeg)

### Landscape Design & Installation

Our design team creates ecologically beneficial, beautiful outdoor spaces. From patios to gardens, we design and install landscapes that perfectly complement your property.

*   Landscape Design
*   Patios & Walkways
*   Planting & Gardens
*   Water Management

[View Design & Installation](https://www.iamgreenwise.com/services/landscape-design-installation)

### Snow Removal

Reliable snow and ice management to keep your property safe and accessible all winter long. Rapid response times and eco-friendly de-icing products.

[View Snow Removal](https://www.iamgreenwise.com/services/snow-removal)

### Don't See Your Area Listed?

If you're in the Chicago or Milwaukee area but don't see your specific community listed, don't stress! Reach out to us and let us know your address. We'll give you a call if we can service your area.

### Check Service Availability

Tell us where you're located and we'll let you know if we can service your area.

![Beautiful back yard landscaping in Bucktown](https://www.iamgreenwise.com/back-yard-landscaping-in-bucktown-480x300.jpeg)

![Natural garden plantings along side of house](https://www.iamgreenwise.com/natural-garden-side-of-house-480x300.jpeg)

![Garden path with red bushes and landscaping](https://www.iamgreenwise.com/red-bushes-and-garden-path-480x300.png)

![Walkway between bushes and green plantings](https://www.iamgreenwise.com/walkyway-between-bushes-480x300.png)

![Garden pathway leading to bench with natural plantings](https://www.iamgreenwise.com/garden-and-pathway-to-bench.png)

Manage every aspect of your WordPress site with a powerful all-in-one plugin suite. Whether you’re an agency or an individual, take control with ease, speed and peace of mind.

WordPress 5 million+ installs

Rating – 5 stars

![](https://teamupdraft.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/banner-teamupdraft-icons-640x300.webp)

![](https://teamupdraft.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/banner-teamupdraft-1-1440x675.webp)

We help you to improve your online presence and achieve your goals. We do that by building best-in-class plugins for WordPress.

TeamUpdraft plugins are actively installed on more than 5 million WordPress websites worldwide. Our plugins are easy to use and many are ‘set and forget’ – set them up in minutes and they’ll do the hard work for you.

You need a rock-solid plugin ecosystem.

If you design or develop WordPress websites for clients, you’re likely maintaining them too. You need WordPress plugins that are reliable, powerful and efficient, so you can keep your clients’ sites safe, and performant.

![Person wearing a blue WordPress T-shirt](https://teamupdraft.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/53806768502_d0c052703c_k-1-427x640.jpg.webp)

## We’re TeamUpdraft

We believe in building beautifully coded WordPress plugins you can rely on.

## We’re experienced

We’ve been building and fine tuning our craft for almost 15 years. Today our plugins are trusted and actively deployed on more than 5 million WordPress websites worldwide.

![Man wearing glasses looking down at and working on his laptop](https://teamupdraft.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/pexels-mizunokozuki-12899141-640x427.jpg.webp)

## We’re the top 1%

Our WordPress software developers are the very best in their field. Meticulous recruitment means we only work with the top 1% of candidates, wherever they may be.

![Two male team members working and looking at a laptop screen](https://teamupdraft.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/IMG_6240-640x427.jpg.webp)

## Our plugin suite

### Back up, restore and migrate your WordPress website

Back up to top cloud providers like Google Drive, Dropbox, and OneDrive. Take manual backups or schedule them for convenience. Restore in just a couple of clicks. UpdraftPlus handles migrations effortlessly, even when databases are large, storage is low and memory is limited.

![](https://teamupdraft.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/bg-upd-640x402.png.webp)

Optimize core web vitals and boost page speed load times through caching, database cleaning, image optimization, and minification. It’s one-click to turn on many of our speed-saving features, with more options available for advanced users.

![](https://teamupdraft.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/bg-wpo-640x402.png.webp)

WordPress website

![](https://teamupdraft.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/bg-aios-640x402.png.webp)

WordPress websites

Get a snapshot view of all your WordPress websites from one secure, browser-based view. Centrally manage updates, plugins, users, comments, backups, and more.

![](https://teamupdraft.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Updraft-central-home.png-640x402.webp)
